query: What does the evidence say about SGLT2 inhibitors and hospitalisation for heart failure?

pubmed.title: DAPA-HF: dapagliflozin reduced heart failure hospitalisation
pubmed.summary: Dapagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of hospitalisation for heart failure in patients with HFrEF compared with placebo.

cochrane.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and heart failure outcomes review
cochrane.summary: Systematic review found SGLT2 inhibitors reduce hospitalisation for heart failure across diabetes and heart-failure populations.

clinical_trials.title: EMPEROR-Reduced trial registry entry
clinical_trials.summary: Empagliflozin reduced hospitalisation for heart failure in HFrEF in the EMPEROR-Reduced programme.
